Label: Study Identifier
Derivation: Copy VS.STUDYID.

Derivation: Copy VS.USUBJID.

Label: Subject Identifier for the Study
Derivation: Copy ADSL.SUBJID for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Study Site Identifier
Derivation: Copy ADSL.SITEID for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Age
Derivation: Copy ADSL.AGE for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Sex
Derivation: Copy ADSL.SEX for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Actual Treatment for Period 01
Derivation: Copy ADSL.TRT01A for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Actual Treatment for Period 01 (N)
Derivation: Copy ADSL.TRT01AN for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Safety Population Flag
Derivation: Copy ADSL.SAFFL for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: Copy ADSL.TRTSDT for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: Copy ADSL.TRTEDT for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Parameter (N)
Derivation: Set PARAMN from ADVS.PARAMCD. SYSBP is 1, DIABP is 2, PULSE is 3, TEMP is 4, WEIGHT is 5, HEIGHT is 6, and BMI is 7. WTLS15DT is 8.

Label: Parameter Code
Derivation: For a collected row, copy VS.VSTESTCD. The collected codes are SYSBP, DIABP, PULSE, TEMP, WEIGHT, and HEIGHT. For a derived row, set PARAMCD to BMI. For the confirmed weight loss derived row, set PARAMCD to WTLS15DT.

Label: Parameter
Derivation: Set PARAM from ADVS.PARAMCD. SYSBP is Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg). DIABP is Diastolic Blood Pressure (mmHg). PULSE is Pulse Rate (beats/min). TEMP is Temperature (C). WEIGHT is Weight (kg). HEIGHT is Height (cm). BMI is Body Mass Index (kg/m2). WTLS15DT is Date of Confirmed Weight Loss >15%.

Label: Analysis Value
Source: VS.VSSTRESN; VS.VSTESTCD; ADVS.PARAMCD; ADVS.AVAL; ADVS.ADT; ADVS.AVISITN; ADVS.SRCSEQ; ADSL.TRTSDT
Derivation: For a collected parameter, copy VS.VSSTRESN from the VS row whose VS.VSTESTCD equals ADVS.PARAMCD. Keep the row when VS.VSSTRESN is missing. For BMI, set AVAL to the numeric WEIGHT result in kilograms divided by the square of the numeric HEIGHT result after dividing that height by 100. Do not round. Do not create a BMI row when either numeric result is missing or the height result is not greater than zero. For WTLS15DT, set AVAL to the event date as a numeric SAS date, in days since 1960-01-01. The event is the first pair of consecutive post-baseline WEIGHT candidates with non-missing numeric result and baseline value for which both AVAL values are less than 0.85 times the baseline value on that WEIGHT row. Order candidates by ADT, AVISITN, then SRCSEQ. A row with missing AVAL does not break the sequence. Create at most one row per subject, only when the pair exists.

Label: Analysis Unit
Derivation: Set AVALU from ADVS.PARAMCD. SYSBP and DIABP use mmHg. PULSE uses beats/min. TEMP uses C. WEIGHT uses kg. HEIGHT uses cm. BMI uses kg/m2. Leave AVALU missing for WTLS15DT.

Label: Analysis Date
Derivation: For a collected parameter, convert VS.VSDTC to a calendar day. In this study VS.VSDTC is a complete calendar day. For a BMI row, use the calendar day of the paired WEIGHT record. For WTLS15DT, copy ADT from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Analysis Relative Day
Derivation: Leave ADY missing when ADVS.ADT or ADSL.TRTSDT is missing. When ADVS.ADT is on or after ADSL.TRTSDT, subtract ADSL.TRTSDT from ADVS.ADT and add 1. When ADVS.ADT is before ADSL.TRTSDT, subtract ADSL.TRTSDT from ADVS.ADT and do not add 1.

Label: Analysis Visit
Derivation: Copy VS.VISIT. For a BMI row, copy VS.VISIT from the paired WEIGHT record. For WTLS15DT, copy AVISIT from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Analysis Visit (N)
Derivation: Copy VS.VISITNUM. For a BMI row, copy VS.VISITNUM from the paired WEIGHT record. For WTLS15DT, copy AVISITN from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Analysis Timepoint
Derivation: Copy VS.VSTPT. Leave ATPT missing when VS.VSTPT is blank. BMI, HEIGHT, WEIGHT, and TEMP have no time point, so ATPT is missing on those rows. For WTLS15DT, copy ATPT from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Analysis Timepoint (N)
Derivation: Copy VS.VSTPTNUM. Leave ATPTN missing when VS.VSTPTNUM is missing. BMI, HEIGHT, WEIGHT, and TEMP have no time point, so ATPTN is missing on those rows. For WTLS15DT, copy ATPTN from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Visit Name
Derivation: Copy VS.VISIT. For a BMI row, copy VS.VISIT from the paired WEIGHT record. For WTLS15DT, copy VISIT from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Visit Number
Derivation: Copy VS.VISITNUM. For a BMI row, copy VS.VISITNUM from the paired WEIGHT record. For WTLS15DT, copy VISITNUM from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Baseline Record Flag
Source: ADVS.AVAL; ADVS.ADT; ADVS.AVISITN; ADVS.SRCSEQ; ADVS.USUBJID; ADVS.PARAMCD; ADVS.ATPTN; ADSL.TRTSDT
Derivation: Group rows by ADVS.USUBJID, ADVS.PARAMCD, and ADVS.ATPTN. A missing ADVS.ATPTN is its own group. A row can be the baseline only when ADVS.AVAL is not missing, ADVS.ADT is not missing, ADSL.TRTSDT is not missing, and ADVS.ADT is on or before ADSL.TRTSDT. Set ABLFL to Y on the row with the latest ADVS.ADT, then the greatest ADVS.AVISITN, then the greatest ADVS.SRCSEQ. Set ABLFL to N on every other row in the group. When ADSL.TRTSDT is missing or no row qualifies, set ABLFL to N on every row in the group. Set ABLFL to N for WTLS15DT.

Label: Baseline Value
Derivation: Within ADVS.USUBJID, ADVS.PARAMCD, and ADVS.ATPTN, copy ADVS.AVAL from the row where ADVS.ABLFL equals Y onto every row in that group. A missing ADVS.ATPTN is its own group. Leave BASE missing when the group has no row with ADVS.ABLFL equal to Y. Leave BASE missing for WTLS15DT.

Label: Change from Baseline
Derivation: When ADVS.AVAL and ADVS.BASE are both non-missing, set CHG to ADVS.AVAL minus ADVS.BASE. The baseline row is included and is zero when the two values are equal. Otherwise leave CHG missing. Leave CHG missing for WTLS15DT.

Label: Percent Change from Baseline
Derivation: When ADVS.CHG and ADVS.BASE are both non-missing and ADVS.BASE is not zero, set PCHG to 100 times ADVS.CHG divided by ADVS.BASE. Do not round. Otherwise leave PCHG missing. Leave PCHG missing for WTLS15DT.

Label: On Treatment Record Flag
Derivation: Leave ONTRTFL missing when ADVS.ADT is missing. Set ONTRTFL to N when ADSL.TRTSDT is missing. When ADSL.TRTEDT is missing and ADSL.TRTSDT is not missing, set ONTRTFL to Y when ADVS.ADT is on or after ADSL.TRTSDT and to N otherwise. When both treatment days are present, set ONTRTFL to Y when ADVS.ADT is on or after ADSL.TRTSDT and on or before ADSL.TRTEDT, and to N otherwise.

Label: Analysis Normal Range Lower Limit
Derivation: Set ANRLO from ADVS.PARAMCD. SYSBP is 90, DIABP is 60, PULSE is 60, TEMP is 36, and BMI is 18.5. WEIGHT and HEIGHT have no lower bound, so ANRLO is missing. WTLS15DT has no lower bound, so ANRLO is missing.

Label: Analysis Normal Range Upper Limit
Derivation: Set ANRHI from ADVS.PARAMCD. SYSBP is 140, DIABP is 90, PULSE is 100, TEMP is 37.5, and BMI is 25. WEIGHT and HEIGHT have no upper bound, so ANRHI is missing. WTLS15DT has no upper bound, so ANRHI is missing.

Label: Analysis Reference Range Indicator
Derivation: Leave ANRIND missing when ADVS.AVAL is missing. WEIGHT and HEIGHT have no reference range, so leave ANRIND missing for those parameters. For BMI, set LOW when ADVS.AVAL is below 18.5, NORMAL when ADVS.AVAL is from 18.5 inclusive to below 25, and HIGH when ADVS.AVAL is greater than or equal to 25. For SYSBP, DIABP, PULSE, and TEMP, set LOW when ADVS.AVAL is below ADVS.ANRLO, HIGH when ADVS.AVAL is above ADVS.ANRHI, and NORMAL when ADVS.AVAL is from ADVS.ANRLO through ADVS.ANRHI inclusive. Leave ANRIND missing for WTLS15DT.

Label: Derivation Type
Derivation: Set DTYPE to DERIVED when ADVS.PARAMCD equals BMI. Otherwise leave DTYPE blank. Leave DTYPE blank for WTLS15DT.

Label: Source Data
Derivation: Set SRCDOM to VS for SYSBP, DIABP, PULSE, TEMP, WEIGHT, and HEIGHT. Set SRCDOM to ADVS when ADVS.PARAMCD equals BMI. For WTLS15DT, copy SRCDOM from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Source Variable
Derivation: Set SRCVAR to VSSTRESN for a collected parameter. Set SRCVAR to AVAL when ADVS.PARAMCD equals BMI. For WTLS15DT, copy SRCVAR from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.

Label: Source Sequence Number
Derivation: For a collected row, copy VS.VSSEQ. For a BMI row, copy VS.VSSEQ from the paired WEIGHT record. For WTLS15DT, copy SRCSEQ from the first WEIGHT row of the qualifying pair.
